name: Chill Medicated CBD Evening Gummies | Blue Razz
description:
Dreamy Cannabinoid Blend

CBD and CBN join forces to quiet the noise and tension from the day. 3mg of melatonin offers a natural signal to your body that it’s time to fall asleep, without leaving you groggy in the morning. And with 15mg of 5-HTP, you get mood-boosting support that prompts deeper, higher-quality rest.

Tastes Like a Treat
Naturally sweetened with fruit and vegetable juice, these gummies are a delicious nighttime wind-down that feels more like a dessert than a supplement. 

Clean Ingredients
No artificial dyes. No synthetic flavors. Just real ingredients that taste good and feel even better. These gummies are vegan-friendly, gluten-free, and made with natural colorants from fruit and veggies.

Consistent, Reliable Dosing
Each gummy is precisely dosed so you get the same clean relaxation and calm every time. No guess work, just a steady rise into your best self.

1 Gummy = 25mg CBD + 10mg CBN + 3mg Melatonin + 15mg 5-HTP

MADE WITH HEMP GROWN IN THE USA
